description: Telangana government will roll out an AI Readiness and Digital Safety Programme across 205 TMREIS residential schools from August 15, equipping 80,000 minority students with foundational AI, digital literacy and future-ready skills through a CSR-funded initiative.
body_lead: Telangana government has launched the ‘AI Readiness and Digital Safety Programme’ for 80,000 students studying in institutions run by the Telangana Minorities Residential Educational Institutions Society (TMREIS). The programme, a collaboration between the Telangana government, Doxa Consulting Private Limited (DCPL) and MASK NextGen Inc, will be rolled out across 205 TMREIS residential schools from August 15. The initiative would be implemented at zero cost to the government, with funding and execution supported through a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)-based partnership.
